Admin routes of the carriers module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/carriers

List carriers

Parameters:

- `isActive` in query (boolean, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `provider` in query (`"dhl"`, `"fedex"`, `"ups"`, `"aramex"`, `"manual"`, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Carriers retrieved.

## POST /v1/admin/carriers

Create carrier

Request body: [CreateCarrierDto](#createcarrierdto).

Responses:

- `201`: Created.
- `409`: Code already in use.

## DELETE /v1/admin/carriers/{id}

Soft-delete carrier

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Deleted.
- `404`: Not found.

## GET /v1/admin/carriers/{id}

Get carrier

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Carrier retrieved.
- `404`: Not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/carriers/{id}

Update carrier

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateCarrierDto](#updatecarrierdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Updated.
- `404`: Not found.

## Schemas

### CarrierTranslatableDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, required).

### CreateCarrierDto

- `code` (string, pattern `/^[a-z0-9_]+$/`, min length 2, max length 50, required).
- `name` ([CarrierTranslatableDto](#carriertranslatabledto), required).
- `provider` (`"dhl"`, `"fedex"`, `"ups"`, `"aramex"`, `"manual"`, required).
- `services` (array of string, optional).
- `zones` (array of string, pattern `/^[A-Z]{2}$/`, optional).
- `isActive` (boolean, optional).
- `sortOrder` (number, min 0, optional).
- `config` (object, optional).

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, optional).
